title: Paper 2 repair: GlobalHalal plc
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 42 (Pupil PDF worksheet: own exam-style questions, case data and mark-scheme points (teacher-written))
intro: Lesson 42. Use the case data in every answer. All businesses, people and figures in these cases are fictional, made up for practice.

passage.title: GlobalHalal plc
paras: GlobalHalal plc makes halal snacks and sells them in 11 countries. It is a public limited company with 2,400 employees. Over the last year it has expanded into three new countries and opened a larger factory in Leicester.

questions.q: Calculate the percentage increase in revenue from 2025 to 2026.
Analyse the impact of expanding into three new countries on GlobalHalal. (Use the data.)
questions.a: Level-marked (6): e.g. revenue +25% and NPM up from 10% to 12%; economies of scale: unit cost down 12.5% (2.40 to 2.10); risks: exchange rates, different tastes, halal certification in each country.
